ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there are two vertical blue straight lines, and they are indicated as parallel lines with the same arrow markings; there is also a blue diagonal line passing through these two parallel lines from the lower left to the upper right. At the left intersection, ∠1 is located at the upper left of that intersection; at the right intersection, ∠3 is also located at the upper left of that intersection. Then reason: ∠1 and ∠3 are in corresponding positions when two parallel lines are cut by the same transversal, so they are corresponding angles.
